vulnerability_analysis: The vulnerability is in the `transferFromWithLock` function which incorrectly checks if `_from` is a whitelist admin instead of checking if `msg.sender` is a whitelist admin. This allows anyone to transfer tokens from any whitelist admin to themselves (locked), provided the whitelist admin has approved the contract. Additionally, we can impersonate the owner to add ourselves as whitelist admin, then exploit the vulnerability more easily.
attack_strategy: 1. Impersonate the contract owner (who is a whitelist admin) to add ourselves as a whitelist admin. 2. Use `transferFromWithLock` to transfer tokens from the owner to ourselves. 3. Warp time to unlock the tokens.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the owner address from the contract. 2. Impersonate the owner using vm.prank. 3. Call addWhitelistAdmin to add the attacker as a whitelist admin. 4. Stop impersonating. 5. As attacker (now whitelist admin), call transferFromWithLock to transfer tokens from owner to attacker with a short lock time. 6. Warp time forward to pass the lock time. 7. Call unlock to get the tokens.
